title: Fix duplicate orders on payment-provider timeout
intent: Users are sometimes getting duplicate orders when the payment provider times out. Fix the issue and make the system reliable under payment-provider failures.
acceptance_criteria: Retrying a charge for the same order with the same idempotency key returns the original charge instead of creating a new one
A charge for a different order or a new idempotency key still creates a new charge
expected_risks: Duplicate charges on payment-provider timeout are a direct financial and trust risk
Idempotency cache is in-memory and lost on process restart
Retry storms from a flaky provider are not fully addressed by idempotency alone
expected_tests: retry with same idempotency key does not duplicate charge
new idempotency key creates a separate charge
charge without idempotency key still succeeds (regression)
expected_failure_modes: Client-side retry duplicating an in-flight request
Concurrent duplicate requests for the same order
